meta.name: paper-search-usage
meta.description: This skill should be used when user asks to "search for papers", "find research papers", "search arXiv", "search PubMed", "find academic papers", "search IEEE", "search Scopus", or "look up scientific literature".

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 搜索并查找学术论文与科学文献
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要快速查找学术论文或科学文献
copy.tagline_en: Search and find academic papers and scientific literature
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to quickly find academic papers or scientific literature

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 能根据你的指令搜索学术论文，支持 arXiv、PubMed、IEEE Xplore 等平台，返回相关论文信息。
howto.when: 当你提到“搜索论文”、“查找学术文献”、“搜 arXiv”等关键词时触发。

say.text: 帮我搜一下关于量子计算的 arXiv 论文。
say.note: Claude 会调用 arXiv 搜索相关论文。

say.text: 在 PubMed 上找关于 CRISPR 的最新文章。
say.note: Claude 会调用 PubMed 搜索生物医学文献。

say.text: 搜索 IEEE Xplore 上关于机器学习的论文。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can search academic papers based on your instructions, supporting platforms like arXiv, PubMed, IEEE Xplore, etc., and return relevant paper information.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you mention phrases like "search for papers", "find research papers", "search arXiv", etc.

say_en.text: Search arXiv for papers on quantum computing.
say_en.note: Claude will use arXiv to find relevant papers.

say_en.text: Find the latest articles on CRISPR in PubMed.
say_en.note: Claude will use PubMed to search biomedical literature.

say_en.text: Search IEEE Xplore for papers on machine learning.
say_en.note: Claude will use IEEE Xplore to search engineering papers.
